review.notes: Full review. Previous R01, R02 and R04-R09 repaired; R03 partly (the ComplexKahlerGeometry 2.5 consumer is not recorded). Gate rerun OK (worker's run build=0); depcheck: 229 roadmaps, 2124 edges, 0 problem(s); no change outside the folder; lake env lean exit 0 with 7 sorry warnings. 147 cited names #check'd at the pins: only HomologicalComplex.Homotopy.homologyMap_eq is missing (R04). Seeded sample verified: Demailly IV (4.9)-(4.15) pp. 204-205; Nicolaescu 7.5.28, 7.5.31-7.5.32, Remark 8.2.2; Stacks 01ED, 01EG, 01ET, 09UY (source sign misprint); Meinrenken Ex. 3.16. Padding probe: 21/21 one-tactic attempts fail. Signatures of all 13 declarations match the README; no binder lost. 36-row adversarial table. Findings: R01 P2, the README re-plans charts on S^3/Circle that Tau Ceti pins as TauCeti.ComplexProjectiveSpace 1 and contradicts Suggested.lean's docstring; R02 P3, the Hopf instance of the converted orbit bundle has the inverse action unless the left action is specified; R03 P3, the README does not record ComplexKahlerGeometry 2.5 as consumer of B6.1, nor give the C-infinity-module form; R04 P3, a wrong Mathlib name and a Layer 6 section title that differs from the README.
